proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.object
proposed_widenings.justification: The item targets objects, not creatures, self, areas, or marks. Its core mechanic attaches adhesive state to two chosen objects or surfaces.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects.

proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface lacks an effect atom for creating a persistent adhesive bond between two objects that prevents separation until broken by specific counters.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once it has done so, the bond it creates can be broken only by the application of Universal Solvent or Oil of Etherealness, or with a Wish spell.

notes: Existing magic-item activation scaffolding is close, but encoding this honestly would require at least object targeting plus a dedicated object-bond effect. I did not author placeholder Dhall/JSON because any current encoding would misrepresent the rule.
